finalText:
Migration done. 12 app files switched `db.query` → `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

One holdout: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` — still `db.query`, but file header says vendored, "Do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade, local changes silently lost." Skipped it on purpose. If old `db.query` is going away for real, fix belongs upstream in legacy-orm, not here.
